_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Nde reiko Player {player_id} LinesOfAction ñembosarái-me.
Ne'ĩra'ã kuéra '{side}', ñande ruvicha kuéra '{other}'.
Mbogue jehasa: `[b1b3]` (kuégui-ko'águi). Teku'a mbogue ohasa teku'a, yvatéte, térã diagonalmente kuadrado papapy kuéra peteĩcha oĩva kuéra opaite sa'y (mayma sa'y). Nde reikua mbogue rei nde rei ñande, hákatu nde rei ruvicha; ñande ruvicha ári reho, reñakãramo.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ñemongu'e oiko va'erã reínte térã diagonal-pe.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ogueraha va'erã distancia ojoajúva umi pieza en línea ndive.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} ohasa {from} -> {to} oñakãramo peteĩ ñande ruvicha.
